learning_outcomes.text: Students can purposefully select production-related methods in familiar situations and justify their selection.
Students are able to descriptively model and compare production processes.
Students are able to transfer known solutions to given problems in the production engineering environment, considering scientific theories, principles, and methods.
Students are able to solve tasks in the production engineering environment in a team-oriented manner, proceeding responsibly and appropriately to the situation.
Students can integrate the results of others when solving given problems.
Students possess the ability to present their own solution results in writing and can interpret them.
Students can identify, break down, further develop systems and processes, and apply given evaluation criteria considering technical, economic, and social boundary conditions.

syllabus_topics: Deep insights into production engineering through diverse lectures and excursions
assessment_rules: Oral exams last approximately 5 minutes per ECTS point. Written exams last approximately 20-25 minutes per ECTS point. The number, form, and scope of assessments may vary depending on the individual selection of partial achievements.
